summary: Kamada Ltd., an Israeli pharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on August 5, 2026. Shareholders approved routine items: re-election of seven directors and two external directors, grants of options to directors, an amendment to increase shares reserved under the 2011 Israeli Share Award Plan for U.S. incentive stock options, and re-appointment of Kost Forer Gabbay Kasierer (Ernst & Young) as independent auditors. This is a standard corporate governance filing, not a special-situation event; no strategic, capital, or structural changes were disclosed. This 6-K was also incorporated by reference into several Form S-8 registration statements, consistent with routine reporting.
